plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the GreenGrove pet insurance site, focusing on the 6-step quote wizard, adjacent flows (claims, FAQ), and recovery paths across desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: The run will start by assessing the landing page and navigating to the primary 6-step quote wizard, validating complex interactions like the ARIA combobox, age toggles, and tier comparisons. It will then test form validation and recovery on the claims page, followed by evaluating the FAQ accordion. Finally, critical flows will be re-validated on a mobile viewport to check responsiveness and tap-target issues identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The quote wizard allows non-linear navigation via the 6-step dot indicator to test backward/forward jumps.
The ARIA combobox for breed selection supports keyboard navigation (up/down/Enter/Esc) and filtering.
The claims form will validate required fields and file upload constraints when submitted.
The FAQ page uses native or custom <details> elements that can be toggled open and closed.
risk_hotspots: quote.html: ARIA combobox for breed selection (keyboard accessibility, filtering logic, 200+ items)
quote.html: Multi-select chips for pre-existing conditions (state management, 'None' toggle logic)
quote.html: Tier comparison table and live quote calculation (collapsible UI, dynamic pricing updates)
claims.html: Form validation and file upload interaction
All pages: Small tap targets on navigation links (especially 'FAQ' at 28x22px and 'Claims' at 43x22px)

phases.title: Landing Page & Navigation
phases.objective: Validate the entry point, value propositions, and global navigation to adjacent flows.
key_checks: Verify hero section content and 'Start a free quote' call-to-action visibility
Test all navigation links (Get a quote, Claims, FAQ, Sign in, Logo)
Check layout warnings for small tap targets on navigation links
exit_criteria: Hero section and value props visually verified
Moved to quote.html via primary CTA

phases.title: Quote Wizard Steps 1-3
phases.objective: Validate the initial pet type selection, breed combobox accessibility, and age input logic.
key_checks: Step 1: Select different pet types (Dog, Cat, Rabbit) and verify UI updates
Step 2: Test ARIA combobox keyboard navigation (up/down/Enter/Esc) and search filtering for dogs/cats
Step 2: Verify breed list dynamically changes based on pet type selection
Step 3: Test year/month toggle and age stepper increment/decrement limits
Test dot indicator to jump back to step 1 from step 3
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated steps 1-3 with different pet types
Keyboard navigation confirmed working on breed combobox
Age stepper bounds and toggle verified

phases.title: Quote Wizard Steps 4-6
phases.objective: Validate condition selection, tier comparison, and final quote generation.
key_checks: Step 4: Select multiple pre-existing condition chips and verify 'None' toggle clears selections
Step 5: Select different tiers (Sprout/Sapling/Oak), verify deductible dropdown updates
Step 5: Expand/collapse side-by-side comparison table, verify live per-tier quote updates
Step 6: Verify quote summary displays correct monthly/annual totals, inclusions, and 14-day price lock
Test floating Back/Continue bar behavior across steps
exit_criteria: Full quote completed end-to-end with verified calculations
Comparison table and 'None' toggle logic validated
Step 6 summary confirmed accurate against previous step inputs

phases.title: Claims Form & FAQ Accordion
phases.objective: Validate adjacent flows: claims submission validation and FAQ interaction.
key_checks: claims.html: Attempt to submit empty form to trigger validation errors
claims.html: Fill valid data and interact with file upload input
faq.html: Expand and collapse multiple <details> accordion items
faq.html: Verify content visibility and state changes on toggle
exit_criteria: Claims form validation triggered and file upload interacted with
FAQ accordion items successfully toggled open and closed

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Checks
phases.objective: Re-validate critical flows and layout warnings on a mobile viewport.
key_checks: Verify navigation menu adapts to mobile viewport (hamburger menu or stacked links)
Re-check small tap targets identified in prescan (FAQ, Claims, Get a quote links)
Validate quote wizard step transitions and floating bar on smaller screens
Check claims form layout and input usability on mobile
exit_criteria: Tap target issues visually verified on mobile
Quote wizard and claims form confirmed responsive and functional

coverage_targets.pages: visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, quote, claims, faq)
coverage_targets.features: exercise all 6 quote wizard steps, claims form submission, FAQ accordion, and all navigation links
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks on mobile viewport, specifically targeting known small tap targets and responsive form layouts

notes: Prescan flagged multiple small tap targets on desktop; mobile validation is crucial to confirm if these violate the 44px guidance.
The breed combobox is the highest-risk accessibility element; prioritize keyboard-only interaction testing.
The 'None' toggle for pre-existing conditions must be tested for mutual exclusivity with other selected chips.
